[index.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/mentalHealthAndClinicalScience/index.ts)

### Tüisık jäne qabyldau

Groups: 5 · Skills: 23

[index.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/index.ts)
